question: Why do the uninstructed regard nādas as multiple entities subject to arising and cessation?
premises: Nādas are perceived as arising and ceasing.
The uninstructed take them as divided and multiple.
This view is based on those observed properties.
inference: Because of perceived arising and cessation, the uninstructed regard nādas as multiple.
plain_english: The uninstructed regard nādas as divided, as possessing arising and cessation; therefore they take them as multiple.
